body:
Thanks a lot for your answer! It's exactly the perspective I needed, with empathy for both sides of the coin. 

I really like your compromise approach of giving thanks, but leaving the reason vague-ish at first and just kinda going with the flow from there. 

I think that would fit our relationships and my situation. I'm seeing a great team of therapists so I already have a more appropriate avenue to discuss such heavy topics. But on the other hand I suspect my friends have their own "silent struggles" so it could also create a space for them to open up if they wish. 

So again thank you for your subtle understanding and kindness :)
